description: This PHP class defines the model 'PurgeCandidateListModel' which implements the 'Normalizable' interface. It represents a candidate's data for maintenance or API purposes, including methods to convert candidate data into an array suitable for serialization or API response. The class uses Candidate entity and gathers specific candidate information such as ID, name, application date, and status.

classes.name: PurgeCandidateListModel
classes.description: A model class representing candidate data for API serialization related to the maintenance module in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a Candidate entity.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the candidate data into an associative array for API output.
